_comment: The promotion trials (tools/hall-private/plans/promotion-trial.md). npcgen builds five quests, Rank D Trial to Rank S Trial, into the hall's plugin at IDs 0x9800-0x99FF (the hall session's grant). Willem briefs at stage 10 (intro first on the player's first trial), the creature is placed at 'spot' (x, y, z, angle in Tamriel), its trophy is a quest item in its inventory, Willem takes it at 40, the clerk promotes at 50. The Rank S Trial waits at 10 until 'waitsFor' (Dragon Rising) is completed, its journal's stage 15 saying so. creature: a vanilla base copied as our own unique NPC; healthAdd to its health offset, armorAdd to Damage Resist at spawn, spellsAdd to its spells, aggressive for a creature vanilla keeps neutral; headless: the base its body becomes when the trophy (its head) is taken, as vanilla's Glenmoril witches.

W0: Staying alive, mostly. Do honest work, often, and when your reputation and experience are enough, I'll set you a trial for the next rank.
intro: Before the Guild officially promotes someone, they have to pass a trial: usually taking down a beast appropriate for the next rank.
I'll mark where it is on your map. Kill it, take its trophy, and bring it back to me. No rules against your party helping out either.
notYetS: I've nothing worthy of you. Not a beast in Skyrim I'd call an S trial, not that I know of. Come back in a while. Something will turn up.

trialAsk: Let me check. Oh, looks like you're ready. That means a trial, go on up and see the Guild Master.
trialDone: Willem's signed off on it. Let me have your card.

trialAsk: This means you're ready for a trial! The Guild Master sets those. Go and see him, and good luck!
trialDone: You passed! May I have your card please?

trials.name: Rank D Trial
brief: There's a particularly dangerous hagraven near the Lady Stone, on the island in Lake Ilinalta.
I'd rather you had another year of wolves, but you've earned this chance to test yourself. I've marked it on your map. Now go and bring me her head.
done: Her head, and you've still got yours. Good.
Plenty at your rank don't come back from a hagraven at all. Off to the counter and they'll update your card.

objectives.10: Speak to Willem about your trial
objectives.20: Kill the hagraven at the Lady Stone
objectives.40: Bring the Hagraven Trophy to Willem
objectives.50: Have your guild card updated at the Guild Hall

journal.10: The clerk at the Guild Hall says I'm ready for Rank D, but every new rank comes with a trial. Willem, the Guild Master, sets it.
journal.20: Willem has set my trial: the hagraven at the Lady Stone. He has marked her on my map.
journal.30: The hagraven is dead. I should collect the Hagraven Trophy from her body.
journal.40: I have the Hagraven Trophy. Willem is waiting for it at the Guild Hall.
journal.50: Willem has taken the Hagraven Trophy and says I've passed. The clerks at the Guild Hall's counter will update my guild card.
journal.100: I passed the Guild's trial and was promoted to Rank D.

trials.name: Rank C Trial
brief: Some idiot put armor on a troll, and now it's loose in Wayward Pass, up in Winterhold. I want you to clean up their mess.
Your map will show you where. Come back with its head.
done: Armor didn't save it, then. That's a C-rank's work, no question. Go and see the counter about your card.

trials.name: Rank B Trial
brief: A bull mammoth's gone mad at Gjukar's Monument, west of Whiterun. No giant herds this one, but it's big, angry, and has a hide as thick as a door.
You'll find it on your map. Bring it down.
done: Look at the size of it. You've done well, and I mean that. The clerks are waiting with your card.

brief: There's a Centurion at Avanchnzel, in the Rift, and it's not like the others. The Dwemer built this one with lightning and steam.
Bring me its core and you'll be an A ranked adventurer.
done: Looks like that Centurion has finally been retired from its ancient guard duty. A-rank. That's as far as I ever got. Go on, the counter's waiting.

trials.name: Rank S Trial
brief: Helgen. Hearing reports of a huge dragon again and there's no one else in Skyrim I'd ask of this but you.
Go there, kill the bastard, and avenge Helgen for what they did. That's your trial.
done: You've done it. By the Nine, you've really done it! First S rank since the Guild came to Skyrim.
Go on and get your card updated; I think I'll just sit here a while.
